original_test_intent: Verify that BMC Web exposes the complete TEMP_CX7_1 through TEMP_CX7_4 transceiver-temperature set and that each module's rendered identity, value, units, health, thresholds and range match the approved transceiver SPEC.
original_method: Verify the target and populated CX7 port/module topology, open the protected Sensor List, enumerate four explicit transceiver sensors, capture filter/pagination/refresh state, map every row to the intended port and module, compare complete fields to the approved module SPEC, optionally corroborate same-source backend telemetry, and preserve evidence without clearing logs or changing ports or thermal controls.
manual_activity: A platform reviewer confirms the four rendered transceiver sensors, their CX7 port/module identities and each module-specific SPEC comparison.
required_inputs: Per-module units, thresholds and valid ranges
safety_requirements: Do not modify CX7 ports, transceiver settings, thresholds, cooling, power or firmware
Do not treat the tilde expression as a working wildcard
Reject CX7 chip and UBB-front substitutions
Reject missing, duplicate, stale or unmapped members
agent_execution_scope: Verify target, route and populated CX7 topology
Compare value, unit, health, thresholds, timestamp and module-specific range
engineer_actions: Approve the transceiver sensor/topology matrix and SPEC
Visually confirm all four UI rows
Resolve absent, duplicate, stale or ambiguous modules

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: `sensor get 'TEMP_CX7_1~4_Trans'` does not prove four resources; the truncated fallback can omit members, and TEMP_UBB_FRONT is the wrong identity.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Capture all four explicit Web resources; only if approved, query each exact backend name separately with untruncated output and prove UI equivalence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Web/SPEC inspection and 3/3-minute estimate remain; generic clear, literal-range assumption, truncation and unrelated evidence are excluded.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build the expected populated-port/module matrix first and bind each UI reading, units, health, thresholds, timestamp, freshness and SPEC result to one physical transceiver.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds deterministic completeness, module identity and freshness gates.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Four plausible temperatures can still represent wrong ports, controller chips or duplicated UI entries.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Absent modules may legitimately alter inventory only if the approved project topology says so; do not invent a four-populated-port assumption.

project_override_considerations: The Project must define expected populated CX7 ports/modules, exact sensor naming and module thermal limits. The preceding chip-sensor case and duplicate UBB-front case stay independent; backend-only substitution needs approved UI equivalence.
expected_evidence: Target/firmware/Web route, populated CX7 topology and transceiver SPEC
Protected browser/session context with secrets redacted
Complete four-member transceiver UI captures with filter/pagination/refresh state
Per-member port/module mapping, reading, units, health, thresholds, timestamp and range result

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Web procedure and SPEC criterion consistently target CX7 transceiver sensors. Generic clearing and the DeepSeek UBB-front output are method/reference defects rather than competing source coverage.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Topology, module SPEC and protected UI are identifiable package inputs. Execution becomes BLOCKED if module sensors cannot be distinguished from controller-chip or other telemetry after the normal package request.

review_improvement: Prevents a literal range query, truncated listing, prior chip-sensor data or duplicate UBB-front evidence from falsely satisfying transceiver thermal coverage.
independent_technical_reasoning: Pluggable transceiver temperature describes module-local optics/electronics, not the CX7 controller junction. Port population and module identity affect which sensors should exist and which limits apply, so acceptance requires an authoritative port/module inventory, four explicit fresh UI resources and per-module SPEC comparison.
